technology_type: Peptide samples were dissolved in HPLC buffer A (0.1% formic acid in water, v/v) and loaded onto a capillary C18 column (30 cm length × 75 µm I.D., 1.9 µm particle size, Dr. Maisch GmbH, Ammerbuch, Germany), which was connected to the EASY-nLC 1200 UHPLC system (ThermoFisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) with a column heater (SCO-2110 pro, China Innovation Instrument Co., Ltd).
